Key Responsibilities Identify, evaluate and communicate with overseas manufacturers, suppliers and trading companies. Source plastic raw materials, polymers, chemicals, additives, masterbatch and other production-related materials . Source and coordinate procurement of plastic processing machinery, auxiliary equipment, laboratory equipment, spare parts and industrial accessories . Obtain and compare quotations, technical specifications, commercial terms and payment conditions. Conduct supplier evaluation and maintain a reliable international supplier database. Negotiate price, MOQ, lead time, payment terms, warranty and other commercial conditions. Coordinate with suppliers regarding PI, LC/TT, shipping documents, packing, inspection and delivery schedules . Work closely with the technical and R&D teams to understand material and equipment specifications before procurement. Coordinate with logistics, C&F agents and relevant internal teams for smooth import and delivery. Co-ordinate with Production, R&D, maintenance, QC and meet their requirements as per production planning and sales forecast. Monitor international market trends and identify cost-effective alternative sources. Maintain proper sourcing records, supplier documentation and procurement reports. Ability to communicate effectively with international suppliers. Willingness to travel to factory/project locations when required. Strong analytical, follow-up and problem-solving capability. Compensation & Benefits Salary: Negotiable, based on Educational qualification, experience and competency. Other benefits will be provided as per company policy. What We Offer An opportunity to work directly with the management and technical team during the factory establishment, machinery procurement and commissioning phase , with significant scope for professional growth in a modern polymer manufacturing business. Mandarin Oriental is the award-winning owner and operator of some of the most luxurious hotels, resorts and residences located in prime destinations around the world, with a strong development pipeline. Increasingly recognised for creating some of the world’s most sought-after properties, the Group provides legendary service inspired by Asian heritage whilst representing the very cutting-edge of luxury experiences. With a pristine oceanfront setting, Mandarin Oriental Jumeira, Dubai is a stylish urban resort overlooking the clear blue waters of the Arabian Gulf and Dubai’s glittering skyline, which is dominated by Burj Khalifa, the tallest building in the world. The hotel's beachfront location and open-air facilities are designed to bring a new level of relaxed luxury to the city. As an Assistant Outlet Manager, Netsu, you will be responsible for the following duties: Support the Outlet Manager in all operational and administrative aspects of the restaurant. Prioritise the required level of engagement depending on the business volumes and other related parameters. Take charge of the outlet and the department in the Outlet Manager’s absence. Enforce and monitor that all operational standards, as per our policies, SOP and quality measures are in place always. Support the Outlet Manager to supervise the side duty schedules for all positions and ensure compliance and follow through. Support the Outlet Manager to supervise the maintenance and cleanliness of the outlet and as assigned carry out monthly or more frequent walk-throughs with the respective engineering and housekeeping colleagues and follow up accordingly on the produced reports to achieve an immaculate environment. Oversee the daily operation of the outlet and manage shifts effectively to assure a smooth and effective overall operation. Maintain a good relationship and steady communication with the Chef de Cuisine and his team, particularly during operation hours. Ensure that reservations are managed well within the outlet and seating capacities are effectively maximised. Constantly identify areas for improvement in service and food and beverage quality by reviewing various service quality audit reports, guest comment cards and guest incident reports, and share observations and recommendations with the outlet manager. Assist the Outlet Manager to plan and execute special promotional activities for the outlets and plan for festive season events related to the outlet. Observe the competition, current market and international trends, prices with the market and other new ideas and forward them to the Restaurant Manager. Able to empower colleagues and communicate clearly with peers, subordinates and superiors. Strong on the job and classroom style training skills. Able to support the Restaurant/ Outlet Manager to constantly update all training materials and keep good track of all training activities. Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English. Verbal and written communication skills in Russian language are preferred. Our Commitment To You Learning & Development. Your success is our success. We craft unique learning and development programmes for various stages in your career so that you grow, continuously. MOstay. The MOstay programme offers complimentary nights and additionally attractive rates on rooms for you and your loved ones. Heath & Colleague Wellness. Finding the right work-life balance is important. Your wellbeing matters to us. A variety of health benefits and wellness programmes are offered to all our colleagues, globally. A competitive salary and benefits packages We’re Fans. Are you?

review_candidates.title: Area Technical Training e Marketing – Addetto/a segreteria didattica e vendita corsi
review_candidates.description: CHI SIAMO CSMT è un Innovation Hub che supporta imprese, professionisti e organizzazioni attraverso attività di formazione, innovazione e trasferimento tecnologico. Collaboriamo ogni giorno con aziende, università, centri di ricerca e partner qualificati per generare nuove competenze, favorire la competitività delle imprese e accompagnare la trasformazione dei territori. Entrare in CSMT significa lavorare in un ecosistema in cui persone, conoscenza e innovazione si incontrano per creare valore concreto. IL RUOLO Cerchiamo una persona organizzata, proattiva e orientata alle relazioni che desideri contribuire alla crescita dei percorsi formativi rivolti a imprese, professionisti e stakeholder dell’ecosistema dell’innovazione. Entrerà a far parte dell’Area Technical Training di CSMT, affiancando il team nella gestione dei corsi e nello sviluppo delle attività di promozione e partecipazione. Si occuperà della segreteria didattica e del back office dei percorsi formativi, collaborando con docenti, aziende, professionisti e partecipanti. Seguirà inoltre le attività di contatto telefonico, promozione e vendita dei corsi. Lavorerà a stretto contatto con i team Marketing e Technical Training, contribuendo alla crescita dell’offerta formativa CSMT e al raggiungimento degli obiettivi di iscrizione. RESPONSABILITÀ PRINCIPALI Gestione della segreteria organizzativa e didattica di corsi, workshop, academy e percorsi formativi CSMT. Coordinamento operativo e gestione delle comunicazioni con docenti, partecipanti, aziende e partner. Gestione delle iscrizioni, dei registri presenze, degli attestati e della documentazione di corso. Raccolta, verifica e organizzazione del materiale didattico. Supporto all’organizzazione di eventi, workshop e iniziative formative. Contatto telefonico con aziende, professionisti e potenziali partecipanti per presentare e proporre i percorsi formativi CSMT. Gestione delle richieste di informazioni e del follow-up commerciale fino all’iscrizione. Monitoraggio delle iscrizioni e supporto al raggiungimento degli obiettivi di partecipazione. Collaborazione con il team Marketing per la promozione dell’offerta formativa e delle iniziative dell’Hub. REQUISITI ESSENZIALI Diploma o laurea. Buone capacità organizzative e relazionali. Ottime capacità comunicative scritte e verbali. Predisposizione al contatto telefonico, alla vendita e alla relazione con clienti, docenti e partecipanti. Ottima conoscenza del pacchetto Microsoft Office. Precisione, autonomia e orientamento al cliente e al risultato. Attitudine al lavoro in team e capacità di gestire le priorità e più attività contemporaneamente. REQUISITI PREFERENZIALI Esperienza in attività di segreteria didattica o organizzazione corsi. Esperienza nel back office commerciale, nella vendita di servizi o nelle attività di telemarketing. Esperienza nell’utilizzo di CRM e strumenti di gestione clienti. Esperienza nell’ambito della comunicazione e della promozione di servizi formativi. COSA OFFRIAMO Inserimento in un contesto dinamico e orientato all’innovazione. Collaborazione con aziende, professionisti e realtà di eccellenza del territorio. Possibilità di crescita professionale nell’ambito della formazione e delle relazioni con le imprese. Ambiente di lavoro collaborativo e multidisciplinare. SEDE DI LAVORO CSMT Innovation Hub – Via Branze 45, Brescia. CONTRATTO E RETRIBUZIONE Contratto di lavoro subordinato full time. Applicazione del CCNL Terziario, Distribuzione e Servizi (Confcommercio – H011). Inquadramento previsto al 4° o 3° livello, in funzione dell’esperienza, delle competenze possedute e del grado di autonomia nel ruolo, in coerenza con le declaratorie del CCNL applicato. Retribuzione Annua Lorda (RAL) compresa tra 25.000 € e 35.000 €, determinata sulla base di criteri oggettivi e neutri rispetto al genere, quali: esperienza nella segreteria organizzativa e didattica e nel back office commerciale; esperienza nella vendita di servizi formativi e nella gestione delle iscrizioni; capacità di gestire le relazioni con aziende, professionisti, docenti e partecipanti; autonomia nella gestione delle attività operative e organizzative; competenze nell’utilizzo di CRM, strumenti digitali e piattaforme collaborative; esperienza nell’organizzazione di eventi e iniziative formative. PER CANDIDARSI Inviare il curriculum alla referente dell’Area Technical Training, all’indirizzo l.zagni@csmt.it , indicando nell’oggetto “Candidatura – Segreteria didattica e vendita corsi”. La ricerca è rivolta a candidati e candidate di qualsiasi genere, età, nazionalità e background, nel rispetto delle normative vigenti in materia di pari opportunità e non discriminazione. I dati personali saranno trattati per finalità di selezione del personale secondo l’informativa privacy per i candidati, consultabile qui: Privacy Policy

You will identify new business opportunities, develop strategic projects, support aftermarket and lifecycle sales, and help customers improve the reliability and performance of their operations. This role is ideal for a sales professional who enjoys developing markets, creating new opportunities, and building long-term customer relationships by combining technical expertise with a strong commercial mindset. This is a home-based position in Morocco, with regular customer visits and regional travel. Casablanca is the preferred location for this role; however, we welcome applications from qualified candidates located elsewhere in Morocco. What You Will Do Drive sales growth and develop business opportunities across Morocco and the North & Francophone Africa region Build and strengthen relationships with industrial end users, EPC contractors, engineering companies, distributors, and other key stakeholders Promote Valmet's Flow Control portfolio, including valves, actuators, controllers, and related services Identify, develop, and convert project opportunities while supporting customers throughout the sales cycle Prepare commercial proposals, negotiate contracts, and secure profitable business agreements Develop aftermarket and lifecycle business opportunities to maximize customer value and long-term partnerships Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and customer needs to identify growth opportunities Collaborate closely with internal sales, product, service, and technical support teams to deliver customer-focused solutions Maintain accurate sales forecasting and reporting through CRM and other business tools Represent Valmet at customer meetings, technical discussions, industry events, and exhibitions To Succeed In This Role, You Have Proven sales experience in valves, actuators, instrumentation, or related engineered equipment for process industries, with a track record of developing industrial accounts and winning business with end users and EPC contractors. Bachelor's degree in Engineering or another relevant technical discipline, combined with the ability to understand industrial applications and customer processes. Experience working with engineering companies, distributors, channel partners, and other stakeholders across process industries. Market knowledge and an established business network in Morocco; exposure to additional African markets is an advantage. Experience in process industries such as phosphates, fertilizers, chemicals, mining, energy, oil & gas, power, or water. Fluent communication skills in Arabic, French, and English. Backed by more than 225 years of industrial experience and a global team of over 19,000 professionals close to customers, we are uniquely positioned to transform industries toward a regenerative tomorrow. Experiencia previa en puestos de supervisión de sala, preferiblemente en hoteles de 4* o 5*. Conocimientos de restauración, protocolo y atención al cliente.
